end

summary: Hyrax is a Samvera Rails engine for self-hosted digital repositories: authenticated users deposit works (with file sets & Valkyrie metadata), collections and admin sets organize them under permission templates + collection types, a SIPITY workflow state machine mediates deposit/approval with comments and notifications, batch import/export (Bulkrax), usage statistics, proxy-deposit transfers, trophies, and single-use links operate around it — persisted in Postgres tables plus an orm_resources jsonb table (Valkyrie) and a Solr index.
